title: IBAN Attestation for Individuals
description: IBAN attestation for natural persons: confirms an individual's ownership of an IBAN, with bank account (including optional account token), account ownership and account provider attributes.

vct.description: Verifiable credential type identifier of the IBAN Attestation for Individuals.

bank_account.description: Core details of the bank account itself (the 'what').

account_name.description: Name of the account, generated by the bank or customized by the owner.

iban.description: International Bank Account Number, as defined in ISO 13616:2020. SHALL conform to the ISO 13616 format: two-letter country code, two check digits and the basic bank account number.

account_type.description: Nature of the bank account. SHOULD use one of the standardized values CURRENT, SAVINGS, BASIC, LOAN, OTHER.

account_currency.description: Currency code(s) used for the account, as defined in ISO 4217:2015. SHALL contain at least one valid ISO 4217:2015 currency code.

account_usage.description: Specification about the private or professional usage of the account

bank_account_token.description: Attributes representing the bank account token

account_token_number.description: Account token, a surrogate for the IBAN that can be specific to the device and wallet; formatted like an IBAN as defined in ISO 13616:2020.

masked_account_number.description: Masked account number to which the bank account token is linked.

token_attributes.description: JSON formatted list of token attributes and values

account_ownership.description: Identifies the legal owner of the account (the 'who'), a natural person.

owner_type.description: Discriminator identifying that the account owner is a natural person. SHALL be present and SHALL have the value 'person'.

given_name.description: Given name(s) of the natural person owning the account.

surname.description: Surname / family name of the natural person owning the account.

parties.description: List of parties involved in the account ownership

full_name.description: Full name of the physical person

account_provider.description: Describes the financial institution that issued the account and related metadata (the 'where & how').

provider_name.description: Name of the financial institution providing the account.

legal_person_identifiers.description: Array of objects containing unique identification strings of the issuing financial institution.

type.description: Scheme or type of the identifier used (e.g., 'EUID', 'LEI', 'BIC').

provider_country.description: Alpha-2 country code, as defined in ISO 3166-1, of the provider country or territory. SHALL be a valid ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.

bic_swift.description: International code (BIC or SWIFT code), as defined in ISO 9362, of the financial institution. SHALL conform to the ISO 9362:2022 format [A-Z]{6}[A-Z0-9]{2}([A-Z0-9]{3})?.

national_bank_code.description: Country-specific code for internal routing within a specific country's clearing system. Optional attribute.

nace_code.description: NACE code for activity specification (e.g. 64.19). Optional attribute.

clearing_number.description: Clearing number for identification of the financial institution, used only in some countries. Optional attribute.

iss.description: Issuer of the attestation, as an HTTPS URL that identifies the issuer.

iat.description: Time of issuance as a NumericDate (seconds since the Unix epoch).

nbf.description: Time before which the attestation is not valid, as a NumericDate.

exp.description: Time at which the attestation expires, as a NumericDate.

cnf.description: Confirmation claim that binds the attestation to the key of the holder (RFC 7800).

jwk.description: Public key of the holder as a JWK.

status.description: Reference to the Token Status List entry that carries the revocation status of the attestation.

idx.description: Index of the attestation in the status list.

uri.description: URI of the status list token.
